owed_from_last_round: hierarchical routing measured against flat routing at several library sizes
method: a 64-skill library generated in 8 categories, every probe written to use DIFFERENT verbs and syntax from its target; three routers; 20 random libraries per size; no model anywhere

hierarchical.note: does NOT rescue word overlap. The literature hoped it would; on this library it does not.

structure.note: nearly flat while the others collapse

the_number_that_matters_more_than_accura.twelve_dangerous_confusions: staging vs production, scale up vs down, start vs stop, delete vs share, filter vs sort, dedupe vs filter
the_number_that_matters_more_than_accura.why_it_matters: a router that cannot tell staging from production REFUSES, and refusing is safe. An accurate router with no refusals would ship to production.

bugs_behind_the_numbers_every_one_found_: the predicate was the whole trigger: 'open the file' contributed the verb 'file', so all file skills tied on the subject and the tie rule refused 26 of 64 probes
action verbs were STOP WORDS: show, give, put, get, make were deleted before routing, so 'SHOW me the file' had no verb left
the first experiment's probes shared no vocabulary with their targets, which measured the experimenter's imagination rather than the router
English inflection is not handled by stripping a trailing s; 'smaller' needed an explicit mapping to 'small'
what_this_does_not_prove: that structure routing generalises to a library whose skill names were written by someone else -- the synonym table is hand-built for this experiment and is the likely failure point at scale

the_honest_reading: word-overlap routing is a dead end above a few dozen skills, and hierarchy over a dead-end similarity measure does not save it. What survives is a similarity measure closer to the SHAPE of a request -- action applied to object -- plus a refusal rule that fires when two skills are equally good. The refusal is doing at least as much work as the matching.
next: drop the hand-built synonym table and see how far structure routing falls without it -- that is the real test
